question: What result comes from meditating on the trident up to the twelve-end-point?
premises: One remembers the trident extending from the root to the twelve-end-point.
One reaches the tip of the goddess-circle and abandons sequential progression.
This meditation produces the state of moving in space.
inference: By meditating on the trident to the twelve-end-point and transcending sequence, the practitioner attains khecaratā.
uncertainties: The exact referent of dvādaśānta in this ritual context is assumed from standard Tantric usage.
plain_english: Remembering the trident extending from the root up to the twelve-end-point, with its tip forward, and reaching the tip of the circle of goddesses while abandoning sequence, one attains the state of moving in space.
